g.text: • CARD strict: four resistance genes at high identity were
efrA 82.6% (efflux). All four are located on the chromosome
(not on the shared plasmid or the prophage).
• ARDB: 17 hits at 41–76% identity — all below the database
Min_Identity threshold (80%), i.e. not counted as resistance
• VFDB: 128 hits, all flagged "Predicted"; the majority match
Interpretation: the genomes carry several known resistance
genes; this should be stated precisely in any safety discussion
and differs from a "no resistance genes" claim.
